title: Colloquy
program_note:
COLLOQUY was commissioned by and written for Colloquy, a trio consisting of Ursula Kleinecke (soprano), Maureen Hurd (clarinet), and Lynne Garrett (piano). It is intended as a short “concert opener,” exciting but at the same time showing how a three-way musical conversation between these talented performers might sound. The total duration is approximately 3’15”.

David S. Lefkowitz December 5, 1999 Los Angeles, CA
